# Dean Tarulli (D): NYS Assembly, District 15

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Dean Tarulli's** campaign website ([campaign home page](https://www.deanfordistrict15.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Paolo Pironi](../pironi-paolo/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/tarulli-dean> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A flood-resilience professional's résumé. The Westchester role checks out. His flood-insurance savings figure quotes only the top of FEMA's discount scale.

1. Westchester hired him as Director of Flood Mitigation and Resiliency.
2. FEMA's Community Rating System discounts run from 5% to 45%; 35–45% applies only to the top three of nine classes.
